issues.where: the stepped pit across the right half, also seen in set-A-01.png
issues.what: similarly rounded slab edges and near-black gaps turn the pit into stacked set pieces rather than a continuous rock formation
issues.fix: vary the ledge profiles and fracture scale, connect the strata down the wall, and recover a little indirect light in the deepest readable faces

issues.what: the repeated dome torsos and hard angular knees look like copies of one rigid model; the closest legs end abruptly in the surface
issues.fix: vary torso and joint silhouettes and the weight on each leg; add convincing submersion and local wakes where the feet meet the water

issues.where: the beige band across the pit and along the mountain foot
issues.what: the pit vapor reads as a broad blur laid over the rocks and the distant band repeats the same curled profile
issues.fix: vary plume density and altitude in depth, have ledges occlude parts of the vapor, and give the illuminated edges directional scattering

issues.where: top right and lower left, the flats beyond the pit
issues.what: the ground texture is dragged into long horizontal streaks and broad smears
issues.fix: break the flats into irregular wet and dry patches with scale-consistent sediment detail that holds up at grazing angles

issues.where: right crop, on the slanted pit blocks
issues.what: the diagonal facets have softly streaked faces and thin, evenly outlined cracks that look drawn on
issues.fix: break up the planar faces with fractured geometry and vary crack depth, edge roughness, and infill

issues.where: upper crops, at the waders' leg roots
issues.what: the cylindrical legs appear to slot into the body beneath an abrupt overhanging shell
issues.fix: blend the hips into the torso with believable skin folds, muscle transitions and contact shading

issues.what: the regularly sized ripple texture continues through most of the surface without enough variation in direction or scale
issues.fix: mix longer swell, patchy small ripples, and animal-driven disturbance while retaining the reflections

issues.where: top left, at the bright shoreline
issues.what: the water-to-land transition turns into a smooth graphic stripe without a credible wet margin
issues.fix: break up the bank outline with shallow sediment, damp discoloration and small lapping highlights

issues.where: left crop, at the fallen animal's neck-to-torso bend
issues.what: the skin detail stretches into parallel ridges along the bend and bunches abruptly at the join
issues.fix: correct the deformation and texture mapping, then add irregular compression and local dirt transfer where the animal rests on the ground
